correctness.rationale: Reconstructed both directions of the exact class criterion. Connected selected fibers project to a connected base subgraph; two consecutive selected inter-fiber edges obstruct every geodesic via the forced unique middle base vertex under girth>=5. When two fibers are selected, connectedness requires an overlap and geodesic visibility forbids two overlaps; one overlap suffices. Enumeration counts disjoint supports, and max/inclusion-max statements follow. Ten full definition-level tests on small graphs passed; no finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: Full cardinality distribution for all high-girth connected bases and arbitrary clique width >=3. The previously unavailable structure shows all admissible sets live in at most two fibers and all inclusion-maximal sets attain size q+1; counts depend only on base order/size. It is a natural exact extension of a newly introduced graph invariant, not a renaming or routine low-order bound.
